acerca.lead: “Sabores de mi provincia” is a web prototype that brings together the traditional cuisine of the 16 cantons of Loja province, Ecuador, so that anyone can discover it, cook it and share it.
acerca.proposito.p1: Much of Loja’s traditional cooking is passed on within families and in the memory of the people who prepare it. The project proposes gathering it in one place, organized by canton, with clear recipes in Spanish and English, to spread it and help keep it from being lost.
acerca.proposito.p2: The platform is designed phone-first, asks for no accounts or personal data, and aims to be accessible to everyone (WCAG 2.2 level AA).
acerca.ofrece.1: One signature dish per canton (Loja has five), with a map where each canton can be clicked.
acerca.ofrece.2: Recipes with ingredients and steps, and a cooking mode to follow them hands-free (under construction).
acerca.ofrece.3: A recommender that suggests recipes by taste and occasion and explains why (under construction).
acerca.titulacion.h2: Link to the degree thesis project
acerca.titulacion.p1: This prototype is the validation instrument of the degree project (examen complexivo) of the Master’s in Business Management at UTPL (EDES): “Scalable digital business model for promoting Loja’s traditional cuisine.”
acerca.titulacion.p2: The project proposes a business model; the prototype lets us test in practice whether that proposal works. Real people use it and give their opinion through a focus group and usability tests, and the results are used to adjust the model.
acerca.titulacion.h3: How the model and the prototype relate
acerca.titulacion.1: The model defines what value is offered and to whom; the prototype makes it visible and usable.
acerca.titulacion.2: It is scalable because recipes, cantons and venues live in data files separate from the design: content can be added without rebuilding the site.
acerca.titulacion.3: It advances in phases: phase 1 works without a language model (the recommender runs in the browser itself); phase 2 will add a generative AI assistant.
acerca.titulacion.4: It is responsible with content: recipes and venues are examples until validated and authorized in writing by the people who hold the knowledge.
acerca.nota: The prototype is under construction. The methodology, sources, validation, license and use of artificial intelligence will be detailed on this page in a later stage.
